description.zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the classroom, returned by calling CreateClass.

description.zh: 是否开启叠加老师画面
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the teacher's camera overlay.

description.zh: 叠加画面高度，归一化为1
description.en: The height of the overlay, normalized to 1.

description.zh: 叠加画面宽度，归一化为1
description.en: The width of the overlay, normalized to 1.

description.zh: 叠加画面X坐标，起点为左上角，归一化为1
description.en: The X coordinate of the overlay. The origin is the upper-left corner. The value is normalized to 1.

description.zh: 叠加画面Y坐标，起点为左上角，归一化为1
description.en: The Y coordinate of the overlay. The origin is the upper-left corner. The value is normalized to 1.
